title: Scalar compatibility and linearity of completed coefficient automorphism pullback
statement:
Let $X$ be a scheme and $d=(A,I)$ a Noetherian adic coefficient datum with finite perfect quotients as in [def-weil-pbc-adic-coefficient-datum]. Use its chosen small pro-etale site, $A_X=\varprojlim_{n\geq1}(A/I^n)_X$, and the coefficient map $s_X:\underline A_X\to A_X$ whose $n$-th projection is the constant quotient map. Let $e:X\xrightarrow{\sim}X$ be an automorphism. Write $\rho_A:\underline A_X\to e_*\underline A_X$ for the map sending every constant section to itself, and $c_A:e^{-1}\underline A_X\to\underline A_X$ for its adjoint [def-weil-proetale-inverse-image]. Let $c_e:e^{-1}A_X\xrightarrow{\sim}A_X$ be induced by the canonical inverse-image limit comparison and the analogous maps for $A/I^n$ [lem-weil-proetale-isomorphism-inverse-image]. Write $c_e^\#:A_X\to e_*A_X$ for the adjunct of $c_e$.

The coefficient scalar squares commute:
$$c_A;s_X=e^{-1}(s_X);c_e,\qquad s_X;c_e^\#=\rho_A;e_*(s_X).$$
In particular, if $s_U(b)$ denotes the scalar section induced by $b\in A$ on a pro-etale object $U$, the sectionwise adjoint equation is $(c_e^\#)_U(s_U(b))=s_{u_e(U)}(b)$, where $u_e$ is base change along $e$. Give module Hom groups the $A$-action through these sections [def-weil-linear-category]. The module direct image with ring action via $c_e^\#$, its specified left adjoint $e^*$ [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-topoi-module-adjunction], and their exact induced derived functors are additive and $A$-linear. For any finite tuple generating $I$, the full subcategory of intrinsically complete objects [def-weil-pbc-intrinsic-completion] is preserved by ordinary derived pullback, and its restriction $H_{\mathrm{comp}}$ is additive and $A$-linear: $H_{\mathrm{comp}}(bf)=bH_{\mathrm{comp}}(f)$ and $H_{\mathrm{comp}}(f+g)=H_{\mathrm{comp}}(f)+H_{\mathrm{comp}}(g)$.
